summary:
Chaser Beta Launch-Readiness Pass (iteration 18). Ran BACKEND pytest suite (6/6 PASS) + Playwright frontend flow on mobile viewport 390x844 against live Supabase project. Verified: (1) fresh @gmail.com signup happy path — hqauto1788839105@gmail.com and hqauto1788839218@gmail.com both created, migration screen 'Cloud sync active · 38 records across 12 tables' renders and Continue routes to tabs. (2) /records/new form loads with the full seed: 2 farms (Home Block, River Paddocks), 3 machines (Big Rig, Case 340, Hardi Commander), 3 operators (You Manager + Sam + Jess) — all with proper testIDs (farm-chip-<uuid>, mach-chip-<uuid>, operator-chip-<uuid>). (3) VALIDATION BANNER — PASS: tapping start-job-btn on an otherwise-empty form (operator defaults to You/Manager) triggers testID='validation-banner' with text 'Fill in the 5 required fields highlighted below.' and does NOT create a spray_jobs row (subtitle stays 0 planned · 0 in progress). (4) SAVE-AS-PLANNED — PASS: filled farm/paddock/machine/area=15/water=70, save-planned-btn returns to /spray, planned card testID='planned-<uuid>' renders. (5) OFFLINE SHADOW — PASS: localStorage after save contains key 'chaser.offline.spray_job.<biz_uuid>.<job_uuid>' with the full job payload; 'chaser.offline.spray_job.pending_ids' is '[]' after a successful network save — confirms cloudRepo mirrors first, cloud succeeds, and clears pending (no phantom pending on happy path). (6) HARD RELOAD RESILIENCE — PASS: after reload user is still signed in and the planned card is still visible on /spray with the same UUID. (7) PLANNED TAP-THROUGH — PASS: tap planned card → routes to /records/new?plannedId=<uuid>, PREFILL WORKS (input-area=15, input-water=70 populated from the planned row). Note iteration_17 said prefill was a known scope limitation; it now works. (8) START JOB from planned — PASS: routes to /active-job/<uuid> where <uuid> IS THE SAME planned UUID (0014dd82-6c66-4a76-8acd-54747116762b) — the planned row is reused as active, NO DUPLICATE. After start /spray shows 0 planned + 1 active card, confirming reuse. (9) ACTIVE JOB SCREEN — PASS: testIDs active-timer-card, active-timer, finish-spray-job-btn, cancel-active-btn all render. (10) LEGAL PAGES — PASS: /legal/privacy, /legal/terms, /legal/support all reachable from More tab; legal-beta-notice renders on Privacy + Terms; ALL 12 checked headings/text markers (Sections 1-10 + Contact + title) present on both Privacy and Terms; support-email-link (mailto) renders on Help & Support. (11) BACKEND — 6/6 pytest PASS: /api/ health, /api/status POST+GET persistence roundtrip, and all 4 invitation edge cases — missing auth → 401, non-Bearer auth → 401, invalid-length invitation_id → 422, valid-length bogus JWT → 403.

ISSUES: (a) MINOR: after clicking finish-spray-job-btn on /active-job/<uuid>, URL stayed on /active-job/<uuid> and the completed record did NOT appear in Recently Completed on /spray (still shows the 2 seeded completed rows). Suspect a confirmation modal or a swipe-to-confirm micro-interaction gates the final commit. Cancel-active-btn is co-located, so the finish button likely opens a confirm modal whose testID we did not detect. This blocks the last leg of the happy-path e2e (planned→active→completed) but the underlying data flow (planned reused, active card renders) is verified. Main agent should confirm the finish confirmation UI and (a) add a testID to the confirm button, (b) verify a completed spray_jobs row is written with status='completed'. (b) MINOR: Sign-out on web preview uses window.confirm() which Playwright headless auto-dismisses, blocking programmatic A→signout→signup-B flow — this is a harness limitation, not a product bug. As a result the full A/B RLS cross-check could not be run in a single browser session. HOWEVER: each fresh business seeds its own set of records with unique UUIDs (business A completed IDs d36443cd/69cfd1e6 vs business B's 18e3ff4e/4297d3a4), and iteration_17 already validated RLS-scoped realtime per business — combined this is strong evidence RLS is intact; a manual 2-context sanity check is still recommended.

Deprecated packages detected: none. No SafeAreaView issues. No React Native red screens. Console noise: only RN-web deprecation warnings ('shadow* props', 'pointerEvents') — no functional errors.

ui_bugs.issue: Tapping finish-spray-job-btn does not visibly commit the completion — URL stays on /active-job/<uuid> and no new record appears under Recently Completed. Suspect a confirmation modal (window.confirm on web or a native Alert) is being auto-dismissed; if there IS a confirm modal, its confirm button needs a stable testID (e.g. confirm-finish-btn) for automated testing.

action_items: MEDIUM: Instrument the Finish Spray Job confirmation with a stable testID (e.g. 'confirm-finish-btn') and verify that clicking it (a) closes the /active-job/[id] screen, (b) inserts/updates a spray_jobs row with status='completed', and (c) causes the record to appear in Recently Completed on /spray with the same UUID as the planned/active row (planned-id reuse continues through completion). Currently the finish step could not be fully validated end-to-end in headless Playwright.

LOW: Sign-out on web preview relies on window.confirm which is auto-dismissed by headless Chromium. Consider using the existing in-app confirm.ts modal (which has testIDs) on ALL platforms instead of window.confirm on web — this would unblock programmatic RLS A→signout→B testing in future iterations.

LOW: Recommend a two-browser-context RLS sanity pass post-merge to confirm no cross-business leak of spray_jobs / farms / paddocks. Signup A + signup B in separate contexts, then verify B sees exactly its own seeded data (unique UUID set) and none of A's.
critical_code_review_comments: src/lib/offline-queue.ts — clean, well-scoped mirror-first design. keyFor uses biz_id + job_id so records are naturally partitioned per business (no cross-biz leak via localStorage). listPending walks the index rather than scanning all keys — O(pending) not O(all). flush() correctly re-attempts and re-flags on failure via markFailed. One nit: findLocalActive iterates AsyncStorage.getAllKeys() then getItem in a loop; for beta scale (single active job) this is fine. Not a concern.

app/records/new.tsx:17 — REQUIRED array has 6 items but validation banner reads 'Fill in the 5 required fields' because operator defaults to the current user via is_default_user seed. Consider making the banner count dynamic from REQUIRED.filter(r => !f[r]) to remain accurate if the default operator is ever removed.

app/legal/[slug].tsx — All 3 slugs (privacy/terms/support) render as expected with a single shared component, legal-beta-notice properly shown only for Privacy/Terms (isLegal check on line 84). Beta-draft disclaimers are prominent and appropriate for the launch stage. Content headings 1-10 + Contact all present and testable.

backend/routes/invitations.py — Good defense-in-depth: 401 on missing/non-Bearer, Path constraint enforces UUID length → 422 for garbage, Supabase RLS gate returns 403 when the bogus JWT can't fetch the invitation. No service-role bypass. Email safety gate (G2/G3) already unit-testable but not exercised here (no live invite sent — per instructions).
backend/server.py — DB_NAME 'test_database' hardcoded default in .env is fine for beta; consider a production DB_NAME override before public launch.

success_rate.frontend: 9/10 = 90%. PASS: signup+migration, seed load, validation banner (5 fields), save-as-planned + offline shadow write, pending_ids clears on success, hard-reload persistence, planned tap-through with prefill, planned→active reuses UUID (no duplicate), legal pages (Privacy/Terms/Support 12/12 markers each), active-job screen renders timer + finish/cancel buttons. PARTIAL: finish-spray-job-btn click does not visibly commit completion in headless (medium — see action items). NOT-RUN in-session: full A→signout→B RLS cross-check (blocked by window.confirm on web signout — harness limitation).

seed_data_creation: 2 fresh live Supabase owner accounts created: hqauto1788839105@gmail.com (Chaser Beta 1788839105) with 1 planned + 1 attempted-active spray job on Home Block, and hqauto1788839218@gmail.com (Chaser A 1788839218) with 1 planned→active job reusing UUID 0014dd82-6c66-4a76-8acd-54747116762b. Each got the standard 38-record migration seed (12 tables). Password Test1234! for both.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Finish Spray Job flow needs a look. On /active-job/[id], click finish-spray-job-btn — the URL stays on /active-job/<uuid> and the completed job never appears under Recently Completed on /spray. Either (a) there is a confirmation modal missing a testID, or (b) the completion commit is failing silently. Check the on-screen state right after clicking finish (screenshot /tmp/C_after_finish.png in this iteration's automation output). To do a full A/B RLS cross-check, avoid relying on the sign-out flow (uses window.confirm on web which headless auto-dismisses). Instead run TWO Playwright contexts in parallel (browser.new_context()), signup A in context1 and signup B in context2, then inspect each's /farms and /spray in-context — no cross-business rows should appear.
rca_of_issue: For the finish-spray-job-btn non-commit: the button testID is present and the click fires (no exception, no console error), but the URL remains at /active-job/<uuid> and Recently Completed on /spray still shows only the 2 seeded completed rows (18e3ff4e/4297d3a4 for business hqauto1788839218). Most likely cause: an intermediate confirm() (either React Native Alert.alert on native or window.confirm on web) is displayed but auto-dismissed by headless Chromium, so the commit branch is never taken. Reproduction: sign up any hqauto<TS>@gmail.com/Test1234!, save a planned job, tap the planned card → Start Job → land on /active-job/<uuid> → tap finish-spray-job-btn → observe URL stays put and no new completed row appears. Mitigation: replace window.confirm/Alert.alert with the app's in-house confirm.ts modal (which is testID-instrumented and works in both native and web), OR add a testID to whichever confirm surface currently gates the completion so headless tests can dismiss it deterministically.
